name: missing_authors
description: The @article entry has no author field. CPR should never invent authors; it should either emit MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD or apply the canonical author list from Crossref/DBLP if evidence is verified/high.

name: arxiv_to_conference
description: arXiv preprint that has a formal conference publication. CPR should emit FORMAL_PUBLICATION_AVAILABLE and, at verified/high confidence, demote @article→@inproceedings and set booktitle.

name: acm_article_number
description: Entry has pages=1--15 but the publisher (ACM) uses article-numbered pagination (42:1--42:15). CPR must NOT invent this — it requires positive publisher evidence.

name: institution_as_author
description: Author field is an institution ({OpenAI}). CPR should emit INSTITUTION_AS_AUTHOR and preserve the original entry until the user confirms.

name: journal_year_vs_doi_year
description: Print-issue year differs from published-online year. Named conflict class online_vs_issue_year — CPR prefers issue year.

name: wrong_paper_cited
description: DOI points to a paper whose title/authors are different from what's cited. CPR should emit TITLE_MISMATCH + AUTHOR_MISMATCH at verified/high confidence.

name: duplicate
description: Two entries with different keys but identical DOI. CPR reports DUPLICATE_PUBLICATION; never rewrites keys automatically.

name: hyphenated_initials
description: Given names like Pai-Shun. Name parser must preserve the hyphen and, if the profile abbreviates, emit `P.-S.`

name: unicode_family_name
description: Family names with diacritics or CJK (Müller, Erdős, 王). Round-trip must preserve NFC form.

name: preprint_no_formal
description: arXiv preprint with no formal publication yet. CPR must NOT invent a venue; the entry stays a preprint.
